analysis: Price has moved slightly above the Value Area High at 84,450, but the breakout is heavily skewed toward perpetual swap leverage rather than organic spot demand. With perpetual CVD delta significantly outpacing spot, the move lacks spot-led conviction and presents heightened risk of leverage exhaustion.
key_risk: Lack of spot bid continuation above VAH, exposing over-leveraged longs to a cascade back into the Value Area toward the 84,300 POC.
